## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the `--exclude` default so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` as the flag default — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns an empty pattern list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says each new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` archive files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test basename exclusions in subdirectories — For `subdir/skip.log` with `--exclude skip.log`, the tests would miss a regression that matches the relative path because all fixture files sit at the source root. — The exclusion tests can pass while archives include matching files from subdirectories. — Fix: Extend `test_collect_skips_excluded_names` with a nested file and an exact basename pattern.
